videos.caption: New cat alert! A call from a wildlife sanctuary about a "weird cat" has led to the first new cat species discovered in over 100 years. Smaller than an average housecat and covered in leopard-like spots, the cat species—proposed name Leopardus tilcayo—lives in Bolivia’s Yungas forest ecoregion, and very little is known about its day-to-day life in the wild. Its discovery is redrawing the branches of the cat family tree, and researchers hope the methods used to identify it could be used to find even more new cat species around the world. One of the things I loved most about making #Animals was getting to interrogate the complexities of marriage. Mark and Abby’s marriage in particular. The masks they wear, the bargains they make, the secrets they keep from each other and from themselves! The film asks: what happens when a crisis forces all of it into the light?  Exploring all of that with Ben was a gift. Since he’s not on social, I can safely say this here and pray that no one shows it to him 🤣 I’ve admired Ben as a filmmaker for a very long time, but getting to be directed by him AND act opposite him was a transformative experience. It changed me as an artist. As an actor, his performance is fearless and raw. As a director, he created an environment that invited EVERYONE to contribute at their highest level -  be vulnerable, take big swings, ask the scary questions, and really dig in. This entire cast and crew has my heart.  Can’t wait to hear your thoughts…. ❤️ #AnimalsNetflix
